signature.instructions: Generate a clear, detailed prompt instructing a language model to analyze customer emails by breaking down the sentiment indicators within the text. The prompt should guide the model to produce a step-by-step reasoning process that leads to a final sentiment classification (Positive, Negative, or Neutral) along with a confidence score. Emphasize the importance of interpretability, thorough evaluation of language cues, and providing detailed insights into how the sentiment conclusion was reached to enhance accuracy and transparency in customer feedback analysis.

fields.description: Sentiment classification: Positive, Negative, or Neutral
